task_instruction: Rewrite each direct request or order as reported speech.
paragraphs: At a professional car-racing circuit, team coordinator Elena briefs the crew before practice. She asked the mechanics, {{red:Check the tire pressures before the car leaves the garage.}} {{mask_1}} Then she told the driver, {{red:Please review the track map with me.}} {{mask_2}} A mechanic reminded the team, {{red:Do not leave tools beside the service lane.}} {{mask_3}}

The crew prepares the car for a practice session. Elena asked the data engineer, {{red:Please save the setup notes from yesterday.}} {{mask_4}} She told the mechanics, {{red:Keep the radio channel clear during the session.}} {{mask_5}} The driver asked Elena, {{red:Please tell me when the track is open.}} {{mask_6}} Elena checked with the race-control office.

A marshal shares instructions with the team before the cars enter the circuit. The marshal told the crew, {{red:Stay behind the marked barrier.}} {{mask_7}} The marshal asked the driver, {{red:Please wait for the green light before entering the track.}} {{mask_8}} Elena reminded a new team member, {{red:Do not walk across the pit lane.}} {{mask_9}} The team listened carefully.

After practice, the crew reviews the car's performance. Elena asked the data engineer, {{red:Please print the lap-time report for the meeting.}} {{mask_10}} The engineer said it was ready. Elena told the mechanics, {{red:Check the front tires for unusual wear.}} {{mask_11}} The driver asked a mechanic, {{red:Please explain the new steering setting.}} {{mask_12}}

The team prepares for the next session. Elena told the driver, {{red:Reduce your speed when you see a yellow flag.}} {{mask_13}} She asked the crew, {{red:Please bring the spare radio to the garage.}} {{mask_14}} A marshal told everyone, {{red:Do not enter the track until race control gives permission.}} {{mask_15}} The team confirmed that they understood.

Before the afternoon session, Elena checks that the crew is ready. She asked the mechanics, {{red:Please place the approved equipment in the marked area.}} {{mask_16}} She told the driver, {{red:Follow the marshal's signals at all times.}} {{mask_17}} The driver asked Elena, {{red:Please let me know if the schedule changes.}} {{mask_18}} Elena promised to share any update.

At the end of the day, the team packs its equipment and reviews the plan for tomorrow. Elena told the crew, {{red:Write down any problems you noticed during practice.}} {{mask_19}} She asked the driver, {{red:Please arrive early for the briefing tomorrow.}} {{mask_20}} The team thanked her and left the circuit together.

mask_1.target: Elena told the mechanics to check the tire pressures before the car left the garage.

mask_2.target: Elena asked the driver to review the track map with her.

mask_3.target: A mechanic reminded the team not to leave tools beside the service lane.

mask_4.target: Elena asked the data engineer to save the setup notes from the previous day.

mask_5.target: Elena told the mechanics to keep the radio channel clear during the session.

mask_6.target: The driver asked Elena to tell him when the track was open.

mask_7.target: The marshal told the crew to stay behind the marked barrier.

mask_8.target: The marshal asked the driver to wait for the green light before entering the track.

mask_9.target: Elena reminded the new team member not to walk across the pit lane.

mask_10.target: Elena asked the data engineer to print the lap-time report for the meeting.

mask_11.target: Elena told the mechanics to check the front tires for unusual wear.

mask_12.target: The driver asked a mechanic to explain the new steering setting.

mask_13.target: Elena told the driver to reduce his speed when he saw a yellow flag.

mask_14.target: Elena asked the crew to bring the spare radio to the garage.

mask_15.target: The marshal told everyone not to enter the track until race control gave permission.

mask_16.target: Elena asked the mechanics to place the approved equipment in the marked area.

mask_17.target: Elena told the driver to follow the marshal's signals at all times.

mask_18.target: The driver asked Elena to let him know if the schedule changed.

mask_19.target: Elena told the crew to write down any problems they had noticed during practice.

mask_20.target: Elena asked the driver to arrive early for the briefing the following day.
